title: Scale timeline symbols with visible event slot width
description: Shrink event icons and content padding when zoomed out; restore close-up size when zoomed in. Recompute on range and viewport size changes; preserve metric lane geometry and item selection. Verify generated bundle and browser measurements at overview and close-up scales.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented range- and resize-aware symbol scaling from local event slot spacing, with 3px minimum and 20px maximum; padding scales with symbols. Browser verified roughly 3px at full overview, 14.5px after close-up zoom, and selecting an icon still opens recorded request details. UI bundle: 6 tests passed. Regenerated the currently served private artifact; no model calls or changes to recorded history.
